title: Process launched through an exec wrapper (c)
description: The code launches a program with execl. Some variants search the path, some do not, and every variant passes its arguments straight through, so a value reaching the program name or argv becomes part of the command. This lexical rule flags the launch; the reviewer checks the argument source.
remediation: Use an API that takes an argument vector with a fixed program path, for example posix_spawn with a fixed program path, and never build the program name from input.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the launch without tracing the arguments.
